title: Kansas neighbour cut 133 trees, some 70 feet onto adjoining land; court upholds $6,500 award
summary_full: A Kansas appeals court has upheld a $6,500 damages award against a man whose neighbour’s fence project led to 133 trees being cut on adjoining land in 2015. The court found the landowner filed his trespass case within the legal time limit and that there was enough evidence to hold Douglas Black responsible for the tree damage.
